name: Puree of Turnips
description: Historical recipe from The Virginia Housewife; Or, Methodical Cook (1824). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Pare a dozen large turnips and slice them
Put them into a stew-pan with four ounces of butter and a little salt
Set the pan over a moderate fire
Turn them often with a wooden spoon
When they look white, add a ladle full of veal gravy
Stew them till it becomes thick
Skim it, and pass it through a sieve
Put the turnips in a dish, and pour the gravy over them

source.author: Mary Randolph
source.originalInstructions:
1. Pare a dozen large turnips and slice them
2. Put them into a stew-pan with four ounces of butter and a little salt
3. Set the pan over a moderate fire
4. Turn them often with a wooden spoon
5. When they look white, add a ladle full of veal gravy
6. Stew them till it becomes thick
7. Skim it, and pass it through a sieve
8. Put the turnips in a dish, and pour the gravy over them
